item.ptxt: When any of the transaxle assembly, valve body assembly, transmission control computer, transmission wire or engine assembly has been replaced, perform [A/T Learned Value Initialization].
When either the engine control computer or yaw rate sensor has been replaced, perform [A/T Learned Value Initialization].
Perform A/T learned value initialization 1 minutes or more after connecting the battery terminal.
Learned values are not initialized (cleared) by simply disconnecting the battery negative terminal.
If the engine control computer has been replaced with a new one, [A/T Learned Value Initialization] is not necessary.
This work is A/T learned value memorization; if the yaw rate sensor has been replaced, the VSC system 0 point acquisition work must also be performed. (see )

step2.ptxt: Stop the vehicle on a level road surface.
Confirm that the shift position is in P, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3, and turn the IG ON and the SST power ON.

step3.ptxt: Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select and execute main menu [Work Support] → work support category [Transmission] → [A/T/CVT Learned Value Initialization] to initialize the A/T learned values.

atten4.ptxt: Initialization takes approximately 1 minutes to complete.

step3.ptxt: After learned value initialization, turn SST (TaSCAN) power OFF and IG OFF, and remove the SST.
Start the engine and drive so that the total driving time at vehicle speed 40km/h or more reaches 60 seconds or more before stopping the engine.

atten4.ptxt: When the transaxle assembly, transmission control computer, valve body or clutch control solenoid (SL1, SL2, SL3, SL4) has been replaced, perform A/T unit compensation.

step2.ptxt: A/T Unit Compensation (Manual A/T Code Input)

atten4.ptxt: When replacing the transaxle assembly (including both ECU-integrated and transaxle-only replacement), perform A/T unit compensation (manual A/T code registration) after replacing the axle.

step3.ptxt: Record the A/T code (5 digits × 12 blocks) printed on the TM label of the supply part.
Complete the transaxle assembly replacement work. (see )
With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to the DLC3 connector.
With the shift lever in P, press the IG switch 2 times without depressing the brake pedal to turn the IG ON.

item.ptxt: The engine will not start.
Do not operate the shift lever or IG switch until the compensation work is completed.

step3.ptxt: Turn SST (TaSCAN) power ON and select "Work Support" → "Support Category/Transmission" → "A/T Unit Compensation (Manual A/T Code Registration)".
While checking the screen display, press "Next" to proceed to the input screen (step 4/6).
Operate the buttons on the screen to input the A/T code on the TM label in the same positions as on the label, and press "Complete" after input.
Confirm that the input A/T code is the same as the TM label, and press "Start".
Confirm work completion on the screen.

step2.ptxt: A/T Unit Compensation (A/T Code Read/Save) and A/T Unit Compensation (Automatic A/T Code Input)

item.ptxt: When replacing only the transmission control computer, perform A/T unit compensation (A/T code read/save) before replacement, and perform A/T unit compensation (automatic A/T code registration) after replacing the computer.
If the A/T code cannot be read due to a transmission control computer malfunction, perform driving learning after A/T unit compensation (A/T code initialization).
Do not perform manual input from the A/T code label affixed to the vehicle transaxle.

step3.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
With the shift lever in P, press the IG switch 2 times without depressing the brake pedal to turn the IG ON.

item.ptxt: The engine will not start.
Do not operate the shift lever or IG switch until the work is completed.

step3.ptxt: Turn SST (TaSCAN) power ON and select "Work Support" → "Support Category/Transmission" → "A/T Unit Compensation (A/T Code Read/Save)".
Press "Start" to read the A/T code stored in the transmission control computer.
After reading of the A/T code (5 digits × 12 blocks) is completed, press "Save" to store the A/T code in SST (TaSCAN).

atten4.ptxt: If the A/T code cannot be read, perform driving learning after A/T unit compensation (A/T code initialization).

step3.ptxt: Record the <Save Date/Time> and press "Complete".
Turn the IG OFF and replace the transmission control computer.
After completing the replacement work, set SST (TaSCAN) in the same way as for reading.
From the SST (TaSCAN) screen, select "Work Support" → "Support Category/Transmission" → "A/T Unit Compensation (Automatic A/T Code Registration)".
Press "Next" to proceed to the confirmation screen (step 2/3), check the save date/time and press "Start".
Confirm work completion on the screen.

item.ptxt: When replacing the valve body or either of the clutch control solenoids (SL3) (SL4), perform driving learning after A/T unit compensation (initialization) upon completion of replacement.
When replacing clutch control solenoid (SL1) or (SL2), perform driving learning only.

step3.ptxt: Complete the replacement work.
With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
With the shift lever in P, press the engine switch 2 times without depressing the brake pedal to turn the IG ON.

item.ptxt: The engine will not start.
Do not operate the shift lever or IG switch until the work is completed.

step3.ptxt: Turn SST (TaSCAN) power ON and select "Work Support" → "Support Category/Transmission" → "A/T Unit Compensation (A/T Code Initialization)".
Start initialization following the screen display and confirm that initialization is completed.

atten2.ptxt: Exercise sufficient caution when performing the driving work.

step3.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Depress the brake pedal, turn the IG ON and start the engine.
Turn SST (TaSCAN) power ON, select monitor item "Accelerator Opening" under "Diagnosis" → "System Diagnosis/Chassis" → "System Name/ECT" → "Diagnosis Function/ECU Data" and execute.
With the vehicle stopped, check the pedal depression amount that gives an accelerator opening of 15%.
From a vehicle speed of 0km/h, depress the accelerator pedal at an accelerator opening of 15% or less and accelerate to the highest possible vehicle speed while keeping the accelerator constant.
If the shift shock is large, repeat until there is no shift shock.
With the vehicle stopped, check the pedal depression amount that gives an accelerator opening of 25 to 35%.
From a vehicle speed of 0km/h, depress the accelerator to an opening of 25 to 35% and accelerate to the highest possible vehicle speed while keeping the accelerator constant.
If the shift shock is large, repeat until there is no shift shock.
